translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: ROMA
book.title: Dos Sulat ni Pablo Atag to mgo Toho ROMA

content: Nokolegguang Kid pomon diyot Ko-uripon to Saa
Na monnu, od ponayun ki vo nod puung to saa amoy'd lampas pe-en kos kopiyannoy to Monama rinit keta?
Konna en! Oyya su timbang id patoy kid diyot kodpuung to saa, de-en momonnu pa man od puung to saa iddos id patoy ron?
Nosorollan dowd no iddot kodboutismu keta, nosokkad kid diyot ki Disas Krays, de-en timbang id patoy kid mandad duma kandin.

Purisu ukit kodboutismu keta, timbang id patoy kid duma ki Disas Krays woy id lobbong duma kandin, su amoy od boggayan ki to lammin umuu, iling ki Disas no duwon lammin umuu riyot kodbadnow kandin ukit to mokososoobbun kotuusan to Monamon Amoy.
Su otik nosokkad kid diyot kopotayan din, timbang nosokkad kid mandad diyot kodbadnow kandin.
Nosorollan tad no iddos mosaasaan botasan no tapoy ron dinit keta, timbang id pakpak don diyon to krus duma ki Disas Krays, su amoy worad kotuusan to saa rinit keta woy dii kid od ko-uripon to saa.
Oyya su otid patoy ron kos minuvu, nokoleggua ron sikandin pomon diyot kotuusan to saa.
Woy pomon to id patoy kid man duma ki Disas Krays, id pomakoy ki nod ko-uyag ki mandad duma kandin.
Su nosorollan tad no novadnow si Disas Krays, woy konnad en sikandin od patoy mandon. Worad kotuusan to kopotayan diyot kandin.
Kosokkad da sikandin id patoy atag to saa to langun no minuvu. Na ko-ungkay, no-uyag sikandin atag to kodposivantug to Monama.
Iling mandad tadda, ko-ilangan no nokota-aw riyot poomdom dow no timbang id patoy kowd diyot kodpuung to saa. Piru no-uyag kow amoy'd posivantug to Monama, oyyos nosokkad kowd diyot ki Disas Krays.
De-en yo kow'd aman nod hari koniyu iddos saa, su amoy dii kow od ikuu taddot morat no mgo ingowollon to lawa row.

Yo row gomita kos ahad ondan no sakup to koniyun lawa riyot kodpuung to morat. Iyon dow puungi, id boggoy row kos tivuk no lawa row riyot Monama amoy'd gomiton din diyot motallong no dontulon. Puungi row ini, su mgo minuvu kow man nid tobbus don pomon diyot kopotayan woy id boggayan to lammin umuu.
Purisu iddos saa, konnad od hari koniyu, oyyos waa kowd man id salig to kodtuman taddot mgo Suhu amoy'd komotallong diyot kod-ontong to Monama, ko konna, id salig kowd to kopiyannoy to Monama.
Dos Kodpo-uripon diyot Kodpuung to Motallong
Na saddook od poko-oseng kow no, “Na, ko ungketen, pomon to waa kid man no-iraom taddot mgo Suhu, ko konna, no-iraom kid taddot kopiyannoy to Monama, od ponayun ki vo nod puung to saa?” Konna en!

Nosorollan dowd no otid po-uripon kow to sokkad no minuvu, sikandin kos amu row. De-en otid po-uripon kow to saa, amu rowd iddos saa woy iyon od ingumannon tadda, idda en so kopotayan. Piru otid dumoruma kow to Monama, iyon od ingumannon tadda, od komotallong kow riyot kod-ontong din.
Dangan, no-uripon kow to saa. Piru solamat to Monama su ko-ungkay, id tuman dow riyot tivuk no pusung dow iddos bonnaan nonaw no id nonaw koniyu.
Id polegguang kowd to Monama pomon diyot kod-uripon to saa, woy ko-ungkay, novovallan kowd no uripon diyot kodpuung to motallong.

Id gamit ku iddos ponunggelengan moka-atag to uripon, su amoy moomok dow nod koovottan kos od osengon ku. Dangan, id po-uripon dow kos koniyun lawa riyot kodpuung to molibmit, woy ayas kow pe-en id puung to ahad ondan no morat. Piru ko-ungkay, ko-ilangan no id po-uripon dow kos koniyun lawa riyot kodpuung to motallong, oyyos iyon od ingumannon tadda, od molinis kow riyot kod-ontong to Monama.
Iddot no-uripon kow pa to saa, worad en diyot poomdom dow iddos kodpuung to motallong.
Na, ko ungketen, ondan man kos kopiyannan no na-angoy row taddot kodpuung dow dangan to saa, no ko-ungkay id ko-ilow rowd? Waa en. Su iyon od ingumannon tadda, idda en so kopotayan no waad tomanon.

Piru ko-ungkay, su nokolegguang kowd pomon diyot kotuusan to saa woy id po-uripon kowd to Monama, od kotanggap dowd iddos kopiyannan nod molinis kowd diyot kod-ontong to Monama, woy iyon od ingumannon tadda, idda en so umuun waad tomanon.
Oyya su iddos bayad to saa, idda en so kopotayan. Piru iddos gasa to Monama, idda en so umuun waad tomanon pomon to nosokkad kid diyot ki Disas Krays nod Longaggon ta.
